content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

Selling design assets with crypto payments is a game-changer for creators in restricted regions or with high platform fees. It allows for price freedom in USD, automated delivery of digital products, and a 0.5% fee compared to Gumroad's 10%. This sovereignty in commerce is achieved through a stack of free and paid tools, including GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, Google Drive, and NOWPayments. This infrastructure is not a workaround, but a base-layer solution, designed to give creators full control over their digital commerce without depending on platforms like Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of selling design assets with crypto payments revolves around a sovereign digital commerce stack. At its core, it uses GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. This stack is designed to be fully customizable, allowing creators to deploy and scale their digital commerce solution according to their needs. With this architecture, creators can unlock the benefits of price freedom, automated delivery, and reduced fees, all while maintaining full control over their digital commerce.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is built for digital creators who sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software. These creators often face high platform fees, restricted access to payment processors, or limited control over their digital commerce. By using this sovereign digital commerce stack, creators can break free from these limitations and build a more sustainable, scalable, and sovereign business model. With NOWPayments' 300+ cryptocurrencies, 0.5% fee, and no KYC requirements, creators can accept payments from customers anywhere in the world, without worrying about high fees or restricted access.

The Components That Make It Work Together

The components that make up this sovereign digital commerce stack include GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. These components work together seamlessly to provide a fully functional digital commerce solution, with automated delivery, price freedom, and reduced fees. By combining these components, creators can build a scalable and sovereign digital commerce solution that meets their needs and helps them grow their business.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack today, start by choosing the right components for your needs. Select a hosting solution, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, and a backend logic solution, like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Next, set up order storage using Supabase or Google Sheets, and file delivery using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification.
